market_outlook.short_term: Volatile but constructive. Oil at $97 and Iran conflict create upside risk to inflation, pressuring bonds and rate-sensitive equities. Tech/AI momentum provides offset. BOJ decision is binary catalyst. Expect 2-3% VIX spike potential. Retail rotation and energy strength support breadth. Key risk: Iran escalation beyond current strikes.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Anthropic $15B, SoftBank 8.8GW, Broadcom custom chips) supports 12-18 month tech outperformance. K-shaped economy creates structural retail divergence favoring value. GLP-1 expansion opens new pharma TAM. Semiconductor geopolitics favor diversified fab locations. Oil above $90 sustained would force central bank policy recalibration, creating 6-12 month headwind for equities.
